scenes.title: The Rock with a Surprise
scenes.body: In a sunny meadow, a little turtle looked up at a big, gray rock. On top of the rock, bright yellow flowers danced in the breeze. The turtle wanted to see them up close, so it began to climb.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about perseverance.

scenes.title: Try Again with a Smile
scenes.body: The little turtle climbed a little way, but its foot slipped on a smooth stone. Down it slid, bumping gently to the ground. A butterfly fluttered by and said, "You can do it!" The turtle smiled, found a new path, and started climbing again.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about perseverance.

scenes.title: The View from the Top
scenes.body: The little turtle climbed slowly, step by step, until it reached the very top. The yellow flowers smiled back, and the whole meadow spread out like a soft green blanket. The turtle took a deep breath and felt proud. And from that day on, the little turtle knew that trying again was always worth it.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about perseverance.
